source.exact_title: Efficacy and Safety of an mRNA Seasonal Influenza Vaccine in Adults

limitations: The source is NEJM correspondence rather than a standalone primary trial report; atoms preserve letter/reply framing and tag secondary reports from cited studies or guidance.
Repeated trial claims were preferentially anchored to the most detailed instance within the correspondence rather than duplicated solely because multiple correspondents repeated them.
The PDF contains unrelated correspondence immediately before and after the requested DOI; those neighboring items were excluded.
No source content was inferred to fill unreported study details, and no web copy was substituted for the Drive PDF.
